How to read this page

World Monitor's Country Resilience Index is a 0-100 structural resilience score. This page records the committed May 28, 2026 snapshot using the pillar-combined-penalized-v1 methodology tag. The full scoring approach — dimensions, sources, and confidence rules — is documented in the Country Resilience Index methodology.

Use it as a crawlable reference and stable landing page. For the current live picture — active alerts, conflict events, market and energy signals — open Serbia on the live map above.
